provenance_note: v3.6.4 patch follow-up. The 57 cases that already passed on 2026-08-22 remain the retained reference evidence; their default/yaw=0 physics paths were preserved. Three of the five red structural/determinism cases were re-run and now pass: semantic WebGPU dispatch contract, ten distinct preset factories, and six-context calculation-record determinism. Two gates remain deliberately blocked rather than inferred: conformant WGSL compilation (no frontend/device in this managed environment) and the full ten-example framework driver to finished calculation records (tool-owned animated runs exceed this headless gate).
reference: Independent closed-form re-derivation in python (numpy/scipy/sympy) plus an independent WGSL front end (naga, via wgpu-native), driving the shipped page over HTTP with every shipped dependency resolved by the server.
reference_citations: Newton, Principia (1687), Laws II and III — impulse-momentum and equal-and-opposite internal forces.
Goldstein, Poole & Safko, Classical Mechanics 3rd ed. — impulsive-force treatment of rigid-body collision; Newton restitution hypothesis.
Definition of the semi-implicit (symplectic) Euler scheme; its global defect for constant acceleration is exactly -(1/2) g dt t (derived in /root/bench3/ref/gen_debrisrunout.py).

Work-energy theorem applied to the bilinear-hardening SDOF barrier law; energy-capacity concept per EAD 340059-00-0106 / ETAG 027 (the numbers here are the integral, computed in the generator, not a quoted table).
W3C/GPUWeb WGSL specification, "Reserved Words": `pass` is reserved and may not be used as an identifier.
naga WGSL front end as shipped in wgpu-native (python `wgpu` 0.32.0) — independent parser used as the referee for case wgsl-compiles.
/root/site/AGENTS.md — six catalogue languages, in the order en,uk,de,nl,fr,es.
tolerance: Free flight X/Y/vz/rotation abs <= 2e-10; the declared semi-implicit integrator additionally checked against its own exact discrete solution at abs <= 1e-9; z against the continuous solution within the analytic first-order defect band 5.1 mm at dt = 1 ms; timestep error ratio 1.95-2.05 (analytic value exactly 2); bilinear barrier energy rel <= 1e-8; barrier inverse vs an independent brentq root rel <= 1e-10; fragmentation and tether conservation re-summed by the harness at the recorded tolerances (mass 2e-15, p 2e-13, L 2e-11, energy budget 2e-13, tether p 1e-12); structural and workflow checks exact. WGSL is graded by whether a conformant front end accepts it, not by substring matching.
